::: {.key-facts}
At the 2022 census, 1,458,154 people lived in County Dublin, up 8.2% on 2016. It had the largest population of the 26 counties.

Its population in 2022 was 3.9 times its population in 1841, the last census before the Great Famine.

In 2025, the average monthly rent on a new tenancy in County Dublin was €2,159, the highest of the 26 counties.
:::

## More about County Dublin

- In 2024, disposable income per person in County Dublin was €33,889, the highest of the 26 counties. [See the map](/charts/economy-income-map.html)
- In 2025, the average price paid for a home in County Dublin was €591,300, the highest of the 26 counties. [See the map](/charts/housing-prices-map.html)
- In 2025, 9.4 new homes were completed for every 1,000 people in County Dublin, the third highest rate of the 26 counties. [See the map](/charts/housing-completions-map.html)
- At the 2022 census, 38% of households in County Dublin rented their home, the highest share of the 26 counties. [See the map](/charts/housing-renting-map.html)
- At the 2022 census, 25% of people living in County Dublin were born outside Ireland, the highest share of the 26 counties. [See the map](/charts/migration-born-abroad-map.html)
- At the 2022 census, 36% of people aged 3 and over in County Dublin said they could speak Irish, the third lowest share of the 26 counties. [See the map](/charts/irish-language-speakers-map.html)
- At the 2022 census, 46% of people at work in County Dublin worked from home for at least part of the week, the highest share of the 26 counties. [See the map](/charts/economy-work-from-home-map.html)
- At the 2022 census, 52% of people travelling to work in County Dublin went by car, the lowest share of the 26 counties. [See the map](/charts/economy-car-to-work-map.html)
- Half of people in County Dublin live more than 0.7 km by road from a GP, the nearest of the 26 counties. [See the map](/charts/health-distance-gp-map.html)
- Half of people in County Dublin live more than 4.9 km by road from a hospital emergency department, the nearest of the 26 counties. [See the map](/charts/health-distance-emergency-department-map.html)
- Forests and woodland covered 4.0% of County Dublin in 2021, the second lowest share of the 26 counties. [See the map](/charts/environment-forest-map.html)
